title: Returns policy
text: BrightHarvest accepts returns within 30 days of delivery for unopened products. Refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days to the original payment method. Opened perishable products cannot be returned.

title: Shipping policy
text: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Orders over 35 dollars qualify for free standard shipping. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days and costs 12 dollars.

title: Damaged goods policy
text: If a product arrives damaged, contact support within 7 days of delivery with photos. A replacement or refund will be issued within 3 business days after approval.

title: Allergen policy
text: All allergen information is printed on every product label. Products are made in facilities that may also handle peanuts, tree nuts, wheat, milk, soy, and egg. Customers with severe allergies should check the label for each batch.

title: Recall procedure
text: If a product is recalled, BrightHarvest notifies customers by email within 24 hours. Recalled products can be returned for a full refund. Do not consume a recalled product.

title: Privacy policy
text: BrightHarvest collects only the contact and order information needed to fulfil orders. Customer data is never sold to third parties. Customers can request deletion of their account data by emailing privacy at brightharvest example.

title: Warranty policy
text: BrightHarvest kitchen appliances carry a 2 year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. The warranty does not cover damage from misuse or normal wear.

title: Subscription policy
text: Subscriptions can be paused or cancelled at any time before the next billing date. Paused subscriptions resume on the date chosen by the customer. No cancellation fee applies.

title: Price match policy
text: BrightHarvest does not offer price matching with other retailers. Promotional prices apply only during the stated promotion period.

title: Bulk order policy
text: Orders of more than 100 units of a single product qualify for a bulk discount of 10 percent. Contact the sales team at least 10 business days before the required delivery date.

title: Gift card policy
text: Gift cards are valid for 24 months from purchase. Gift cards cannot be exchanged for cash. Lost gift cards cannot be replaced without proof of purchase.

title: Age restriction policy
text: Products containing coffee or caffeinated ingredients are not recommended for children under 12 years. No age verification is required at checkout.

title: Complaint handling policy
text: Complaints are acknowledged within 2 business days and resolved within 10 business days. Customers receive a case number for every complaint.

title: Product safety policy
text: All BrightHarvest products are tested for safety before release. Batch numbers are printed on every package so any batch can be traced.

title: Delivery area policy
text: BrightHarvest delivers to the continental United States. Delivery to Alaska and Hawaii takes 7 to 10 business days and carries a 15 dollar surcharge.

title: Payment policy
text: BrightHarvest accepts major credit cards, debit cards, and gift cards. Cash on delivery is not available. Payment is taken at the time of order.

title: Coupon policy
text: Only one coupon code can be used per order. Coupons cannot be combined with bulk discounts. Expired coupons cannot be reactivated.

title: Sustainability policy
text: BrightHarvest aims to use 100 percent recyclable packaging by 2028. Current packaging is 80 percent recyclable. Customers can return packaging through the recycling programme.

title: Out of stock policy
text: If a product is out of stock, customers can join a waitlist and are notified by email when it is back in stock. Waitlisted orders are not charged until the product ships.

title: Contact policy
text: Customer support is available Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm Eastern Time, by email and chat. Phone support is available Monday to Friday, 10am to 4pm Eastern Time.

title: How to store granola
text: Store BrightHarvest Almond Crunch Granola in a cool dry place in a sealed container. Once opened, use within 60 days for best freshness.

title: Oat bars melting
text: If Honey Oat Bars melt in heat, place them in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. They are safe to eat after chilling and do not need to be discarded.

title: Cereal going stale
text: Keep Berry Burst Cereal in a sealed container after opening. If it goes stale, it is safe to eat but the texture changes. Use within 30 days of opening.

title: Coffee beans grinding
text: Grind Cold Brew Coffee Beans coarse for cold brew. Use 80 grams of beans per litre of cold water and steep for 12 to 16 hours.

title: Green tea brewing
text: Brew Green Tea Blend with water at 80 degrees Celsius for 2 to 3 minutes. Do not use boiling water, as it makes the tea bitter.

title: Peanut butter separation
text: Natural oil separation in Peanut Butter Crunch is normal. Stir well before use. Refrigeration slows separation but makes spreading harder.

title: Pasta sauce after opening
text: After opening Tomato Basil Pasta Sauce, refrigerate it and use within 7 days. Do not store an opened jar at room temperature.

title: Pasta cooking time
text: Cook Whole Wheat Pasta for 9 to 11 minutes in boiling salted water. Drain and serve immediately for best texture.

title: Chocolate blooming
text: White spots on Dark Chocolate Squares are called bloom. Bloom is harmless and the chocolate is safe to eat, though the texture may change.

title: Crackers soft
text: If Sea Salt Crackers become soft, warm them in an oven at 150 degrees Celsius for 5 minutes and let them cool. They will crisp again.

title: Smoothie mix lumps
text: Shake Mango Smoothie Mix well before use. If lumps remain, blend for 20 seconds. Lumps are caused by settling and are not a defect.

title: Oat milk curdling in coffee
text: Oat Milk Original can curdle in very hot acidic coffee. Warm the oat milk first and pour the coffee slowly to reduce curdling.

title: Quinoa salad kit expiry
text: Quinoa Salad Kit must be kept refrigerated at 2 to 4 degrees Celsius and used by the date printed on the pack. Do not eat after the use-by date.

title: Lentil soup thickness
text: Lentil Soup Mix thickens as it cools. Add 100 millilitres of water per serving when reheating to restore the original consistency.

title: Roasted almonds rancid
text: Roasted Almonds Sea Salt can taste rancid if stored in heat. Store in a cool dry place and use within 90 days of opening.

title: Oatmeal clumping
text: Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal can clump if water is added too quickly. Add hot water slowly while stirring for a smooth texture.

title: Coconut water sour
text: Coconut Water Natural tastes sour if left open for more than 3 days. Discard opened coconut water after 3 days.

title: Veggie chips broken
text: Veggie Chips Beetroot are fragile and some breakage in transit is normal. If more than half the bag is broken, contact support within 7 days.

title: Dressing separation
text: Honey Mustard Dressing separates naturally. Shake well before each use. Separation does not mean the dressing has gone bad.

title: Rice cooking ratio
text: Cook Brown Rice Basmati with a ratio of 1 part rice to 2 parts water. Simmer covered for 40 minutes, then rest for 10 minutes.

title: Hazelnut spread hardening
text: Chocolate Hazelnut Spread hardens in the refrigerator. Leave it at room temperature for 20 minutes before spreading.

title: Seasoning clumping
text: Lemon Herb Seasoning can clump in humidity. Store with the lid tightly closed in a dry place. Break up clumps with a fork.

title: Protein bar hard
text: Protein Bar Chocolate Peanut can become hard in cold weather. Warm it in your hands for a few minutes to soften it before eating.

title: Yogurt cups expiry
text: Strawberry Yogurt Cups must be kept refrigerated and used by the date on the lid. Do not eat yogurt that smells sour or has mould.

title: Orange juice pulp
text: Orange Juice Cold Pressed contains natural pulp that settles. Shake well before drinking. Pulp settling is normal and not a defect.

title: Bread mix rising
text: Whole Grain Bread Mix needs warm water at 35 degrees Celsius to activate the yeast. Cold water slows rising and the loaf may be dense.

title: Maple syrup crystallisation
text: Maple Syrup Pure can crystallise in cold storage. Warm the bottle gently in warm water to dissolve the crystals.

title: Chickpea pasta foam
text: Chickpea Pasta Fusilli produces foam when boiling. Use a larger pot and stir occasionally to prevent the foam from boiling over.

title: Turmeric latte staining
text: Turmeric Latte Mix can stain cups and clothing. Rinse cups immediately after use with cold water before washing.

title: Jam mould
text: If Mixed Berry Jam has mould on the surface, discard the whole jar. Do not scrape off the mould and eat the rest.
